notes.title: Hotfix 0.3.3
notes.notes:
[h2]Hotfix: Virus Infinite version 0.3.3 is out. [/h2]

[b]Greetings, Virus Busters![/b]

We are very happy to submit quick hotfix. Big thanks to @JonDatFlindo for reporting found bug!

Change log:
-Fix bug that sometimes pills could go above the lift and remain not destroyed - what blocked further progress of the game. 
-Add congratulations screen for people that reached level 10.
-Add Discord button in Main Menu.

We want to ensure you, that we read carefully all reviews.
If you see any other bugs or have any ideas to improve the game, just send us an email to support@skyworldgames.com or join our Discord channel.

-Sky World Games Team

notes.title: Virus Infinite 0.3.2 Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Virus Busters![/h2]

Welcome to the second big Virus Infinite update! Firstly, big thanks to all people playing the game, sharing their feedback, new ideas and encountered bugs. This game would have never be as good without you. This is the second of four planned major updates for Virus Infinite.

[i]Note: we have changed our version calculation from 1.x.x to 0.x.x because it could be misleading for players that game is already fully finished, but we have much more ideas to add before the final release.[/i]

[h2]Main new features:[/h2]

[h3]Player skills[/h3]

Bring with you 1 skill of each type: attack, utility, defense, and gain even more deadly power against viruses. Destroy viruses of each color to fuel your energy power bars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44178704/8213966120cbbd1d0ede3732be6c89f389c89647.png[/img]

[h3]Player levels[/h3]

Gain experience and level up your account to unlock even deadlier skills! For now 10 lvl is max.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44178704/d743b41c6916222fbe892c560703e7f05144c8e0.png[/img]

[h3]Global leaderboards[/h3]

Compare your progress with other player in 4 categories: Infinite score, Infinite destroyed viruses, Infinite reached depth, Classic score.
[i](As this is still early access version, there might be leaderboards reset after final release. We also may balance scores multipliers from time to time, to achieve as fair experience as possible).[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44178704/771ecd601a1211637f3e34e4daa62c7542b042a6.png[/img]

[h2]Full list of changes:[/h2]

[h3]Features:[/h3]
-12 unique player skills (previous power pill is now one of the skills)
-Player can gain experience and level up unlocking skills.
-Global leaderboards
-Fancy loading screen after opening the game
-Profile tab in main menu

[h3]Neat Tweaks for a Better Experience:[/h3]
-Change version calculation from 1.x.x to 0.x.x
-Make viruses spawn lower on the arena in Infinite mode
-Add "Play again" button to the End Game screen
-Improve disappearing effect for destroyed pills
-Add more detailed description of each mode in game details screen
-Change calculations for viruses spawn rate, so game play is smoother and arena is not flooded with viruses too fast
-Add "recommended" text to Infinite play mode - we have noticed that many of our players tried only Classic mode, which is legacy mode without new features. So we would like to emphasize that Infinite mode is the default one.

[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
-Fix bug that sometimes after moving lift down, next spawned pill would fall very quickly
-Fix very rare bug that sometimes 4 pills of the same color wouldn't be destroyed
-Fix bug that after restarting game, music would be restarted once immediately and second time after 2 seconds


We really hope that you will enjoy this update! Please share your feedback - we are always more than happy to get new ideas from our community.

Join our Discord channel to have access to all news and surveys: https://discord.com/invite/s9d2QHSaxK

Get rid of viruses and become truly a Virus Buster!

-Sky World Games Team

notes.title: Virus Infinite 1.2.0 Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Virus Busters![/h2]

Welcome to the first big Virus Infinite update! We would like to thank to all people playing the game, sharing their feedback, new ideas and encountered bugs. This game would have never be as good without you. This is one of four planned major updates for Virus Infinite.

[h2]Main new features:[/h2]

[h3]3 arena sizes[/h3]

Enjoy eradicating viruses in 3 unique arena sizes. Don't think that small size is easy, actually it requires even more strategic thinking.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44178704/98bda8f2b8236ab8fbfb78a4b005a2acc39e0eb3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44178704/d50d96e85b0619305881812ebddf51e4052471e7.png[/img][/url]

[h3]5 new music themes[/h3]

Enjoy the game with 5 new music tracks created by Polish musician and composer - Marcin Stachowicz. 2 of them (and previous music) are selectable as starting themes, but to listen another 3 you need to progress in Infinite game mode.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44178704/75f61c8671ca33dc5f04eab649a33257a966b9d4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44178704/e11dd2af7ebe541c6dbf56f41a801bde88d222d9.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Improved player HUD[/h3]

We found out that it's a little bit tricky to track "Next Pill" as it's too far for the eye to naturally focus on it during the game. That's why we decided to redesign the whole HUD. This is our new proposition for player UI together with new planets that have arrived to the VI universe:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44178704/b258ab53e52825b48f50f21cafefde0b155c505d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44178704/abba69759c96b27593ef88cbe37eaf7316aa5257.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Full list of changes:[/h2]

-Choose from three different arena sizes to start your adventure!
-Select your favourite theme from three types of starting music before diving into the game!
-Discover new music tracks that kick in as the game becomes more challenging in infinite mode.
-Viruses now have a new trick - they can toss random tiles at you as the difficulty level goes up (only in infinite mode)!
-Enjoy a galactic view with planets added to the background!
-Your player HUD gets a cool makeover for a cleaner and handier look!
-Get helpful info about the power pill when you collect enough energy for the first time!

Neat Tweaks for a Better Experience:

-Close the 'How to Play' panel easily with just the enter or esc keys!
-Viruses now come in better colors to avoid combinations that can be defeated with one pill!
-See the next pill right after the arena level loads, so you can plan where to put it!
-Ensure that game is always capped to 60 FPS

We really hope that you will enjoy this update! Please share your feedback - we are always more than happy to get new ideas from our community.

Join our Discord channel to have access to all news and surveys: https://discord.gg/KEEMUddPy

Get rid of viruses and become truly a Virus Buster!

-Sky World Games Team

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.1
notes.notes:
[b]Hotfix: Virus Infinite version 1.1.1 is out. [/b]

We are very happy to submit our first hotfix. Thanks to all the people reporting those bugs and helping us develop better game! 

Change log:
-Fix bug that game could freeze just before moving lift down
-Add better calculations for quantity of new appearing viruses in Infinite mode (this mode is about getting deeper, so we found out that arena was filled with viruses too quickly)
-Add better calculations for increasing pill falling speed - game was not playable too quickly, so we made speed transitions much smoother. Starting speed for all modes remains the same
-Fix very rare bug that after lift moving down it was possible that new viruses wouldn't be destroyed, even if there are 3 correct color pills on top of them
-Fix bug that it was possible to hear "change difficulty" sound even when the game was already over.
-Fix bug in high score panel that "Continue" button was still clickable after submitting name and was adding duplicated entry of the current score

We want to ensure you, that we read carefully all reviews.
If you see any other bugs or have any ideas to improve the game, just send us an email to support@skyworldgames.com
